# weave commands

Every `weave` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `weave:dedup`

Find and merge near-duplicate Weave nodes (same kind + content-token set). Dry-run unless --apply.

```bash
bin/semitexa weave:dedup
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--apply` | no |
| `--merge` | yes |
